abstract: We report a case of hepatic teratoma that occurred in a 21-week-old fetus with anencephaly. This mature teratoma showed tissue derived from all three germ cell layers. To our knowledge, hepatic teratoma associated with anencephaly has not been reported previously.
abstract_ja: 21週齢の無脳症胎児に発生した肝奇形腫の症例を報告する。この成熟奇形腫は三胚葉すべてに由来する組織を含んでいた。我々の知る限り、無脳症に伴う肝奇形腫はこれまで報告されていない。
